identificationModule.briefTitle: Sufentanil Pharmacokinetics After Intra Amniotic Injection
identificationModule.officialTitle: Assessment of Fetal and Maternal Sufentanil Pharmacokinetics After Intra-amniotic Injection

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The fetus may be exposed during pregnancy to nociceptive stimuli because of fetal pathology (e.g., malformation) or a diagnostic or therapeutic procedure.

To date, there is very little data and no consensus on fetal analgesia. The aim of the investigators study is to evaluate the pharmacokinetics of Sufentanil after intra amniotic injection.

interventions.name: Sufentanil
interventions.description: intra-amniotic injection of 10 micrograms of Sufentanil

primaryOutcomes.description: fetal plasma concentrations of morphine derivatives by Ultrahigh Pressure Liquid Chromatography (UPLC) with mass spectometry (Triple Quadrupole Detector)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Maternal plasma concentrations of morphine derivatives by Ultrahigh Pressure Liquid Chromatography (UPLC) with mass spectometry (Triple Quadrupole Detector)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: at 30 minutes and at 1, 2, 4, 8, 24 hours after intra-amniotic injection

secondaryOutcomes.description: The amniotic fluid concentrations of morphine derivatives by Ultrahigh Pressure Liquid Chromatography (UPLC) with mass spectometry (Triple Quadrupole Detector)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Immediately within 5 min after intra-amniotic injection

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Termination of pregnancy for fetal malformation
* Gestational age \> 24 weeks of gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Multiple pregnancy
* Allergy or contraindication to sufentanil
* Morphinic addiction
* fetal gastroschisis, omphalocele or swallowing disorder
* maternal cardiac or respiratory distress
